about.title: About
about.description:
Welcome to my web platform built with React.
 This site brings together some of my projects and repositories, and showcases my work.
 Feel free to explore the features and learn more about what I do.
 Account creation is being improved and will be available soon.

features.title: Features
features.description:
Current features are limited at the moment.
User authentication (registration, login) is in place.
Once logged in, you will be able to access additional features and exclusive content.
Please note that some features may not be fully operational or may require a login.
Lost Ark integration is currently under development.

projects.intro: Welcome to my personal projects page. This page showcases a selection of projects I have developed to deepen my programming skills and explore new technologies. Each project reflects my passion for software development and my commitment to continuous learning.

gma.description: GameMasterArtefact is a Discord bot designed for game masters and online role-playing game players. It allows you to manage characters, character sheets, and execute specific commands to facilitate the flow of game sessions.
gma.note: You can get more information about the commands by clicking the arrow next to the command name.
